brief:
A complaint has been filed in Vietnam against an Israeli tourist identified as a reserve soldier, Shehab Wire reported, accusing him of involvement in destroying homes in Gaza. The Israeli news site Walla reported the case as legal proceedings continue against Israeli citizens over alleged destruction in the Palestinian territory.

The filing marks another instance in an expanding pattern of legal action targeting Israeli military personnel abroad in connection with operations in Gaza.

title: Vietnam files complaint against Israeli tourist over Gaza home destruction
